name: my-workflow
description: A spec-driven software workflow for Claude Code and GitHub Copilot that keeps a human in control of agent-written code. drive-spec decides the kind of task (feature, bug or improvement), keeps specs/<task>/workflow.yaml, settles the requirements (or a bug's diagnosis), the design and the plan with you through the spec-* skills, then delegates the tests, the code and the review to the spec-tester, spec-implementer and spec-code-reviewer agents with one fixed prompt format; spec-design-reviewer checks a design on your yes. Every story, criterion, design unit and workaround has a stable id; each criterion is backed by evidence of behaviour, normally a test in the project's own suite; scripts/spec-check.py decides the gates and writes a coverage report; you approve the requirements, the design, and any workaround or waiver. Standalone skills: rephrase, discuss, audit-truth (a unit atlas of existing code and its dependencies: build, query, distill), scaffold-project-structure, design-component, analyze-ui-state. code-auditor builds an atlas as a session agent.
